lines.text: I am YANA, your robot assistant. I will guide you tonight.
Water, oxygen, food and energy. The white mark is tonight's goal.
The crew uses water, oxygen and food. If we do nothing, the bars drop.
Six hours. Each action takes one hour. The clock never stops.
Tap the blue door. Let's melt some ice.
Red light! The filter is dirty. Fix it before the plant stops.
Well done. Now refill the bar that is furthest from its mark.
A red door light means a broken room.
Dust storm coming. Filters will clog and panels give half.
Pre-filters ready. Only one filter will clog.
The cleaning robot keeps the panels at full power.
Last night. The colonists land at dawn. Look: a huge solar flare.
The shielding will protect half the machines.
Water Plant. Tap the ice melter.
Oxygen Room. Tap the electrolyzer.
Greenhouse. Tap the shelf to harvest.
Energy Room. Tap the window to aim the panels.
{fault} in the {room}! One hour before it stops.
The {room} has stopped.
Dust clogged the {room} filter!
Sol... ar storm! No sig... nal. Res... tart the rooms.
Dawn. Shift over.
Build at least 3 upgrades. You need storage and machines.
Dust storm tonight. Pre-filters and the robot help.
Solar storm on the last night. Shield the machines.
Right answer: +1 work today.

hielo: Mars has no rivers: its water is frozen under the ground.
Melting ice needs heat, so it costs energy.
There are whole layers of ice under the Martian dust.
electro: The electrolyzer splits water into oxygen and hydrogen, like on the Space Station.
Every water molecule, H₂O, has one oxygen atom.
cosecha: A lettuce is almost all water.
Astronauts have grown and eaten lettuce on the Space Station.
Plants take in CO₂ and give out oxygen.
paneles: Clean panels give much more energy.
Mars gets less than half the sunlight Earth gets.
The Spirit and Opportunity rovers ran on solar panels.

solarRepair: Room back online. Machines are weak after the storm.
clogRepair: Filter clean. Martian dust storms can cover the whole planet for weeks.

intro.text: Commander? Commander! Good, you are awake.
It is {year}. Earth can no longer keep us alive.
You lead Project Phoenix: the first home for humans on Mars.
The colonists land in four nights. If this base is not ready, they will have nowhere to live.
The future of humanity is in your hands. Let me show you how it works.

hint.back: All good here. Go back to Control.
hint.blind: No sig... nal. Check every room.
hint.wait: Bars look good. You can wait.
